annotations.title: What a basket cost on an earlier date

description:
How the cost of the same basket changed between two dates, at the store
    it was bought from: each product's price on both dates, whether it was on
    promotion, the basket total on each date, and the products that moved it.
    BasketWatch has recorded every product's price every night since May 2026
    (Lidl's since 17 October 2026).
    Up to 100 lines per call; each line takes name, sku (the retailer's printed
    item number, with the line's words in name), barcode, store and quantity.

    change_pct is the change in what the basket cost (promotions included);
    shelf_change_pct is regular prices only, so the gap between the two is
    promotions starting or ending, not price rises. biggest_rises and
    biggest_falls list the lines that moved most; pack_changed marks a product
    whose pack size changed, confirmed over three days of records (a smaller
    pack at the same price is a hidden rise). Lines in not_compared were not
    found, or not sold on one of the dates.

    Each product compared costs one credit.

    Args:
        items: e.g. [{"sku": "100858349", "quantity": 2}, {"name": "brennans wholemeal bread"}].
        from_date: the earlier date, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-08-06".
        to_date: the later date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today.
        store: the receipt's supermarket (aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl).
